status: VISUAL REFERENCE VALIDATION - documentation only, no assets collected
purpose: Per-SOURCE license classification for the Profile-B visual reference library. Records each source's KNOWN policy + reuse permissions. IMPORTANT: web fetch is blocked in this environment, so individual per-file licenses were NOT opened; every reference carries verify_before_use=true and any direct-reuse approval is CONDITIONAL on that per-file check by the user.
environment_limitation: Only web SEARCH is available (no file fetch). Source-level license policy is recorded; per-file (Wikimedia/PMC-figure) license verification remains a required user step before any reuse/trace/crop.
